name: qlrisk_price_carbon_future
title: Price a CarbonFuture
description:
Price one Carbon Future (qlrisk CarbonFuture): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), is_future (default false), strike, quantity, ticker (default SPX), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, spot, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
